description: Create a QLab OSC control bridge using the OSC router matrix primitive. It exposes /go, /stop, /panic, /pause, /resume, /reset and optional /cue/{number}/start routes to QLab's configurable OSC receive port, without requiring QLab to be running during build.

cue_numbers.description: Optional QLab cue numbers to expose as /cue/{number}/start routes.

name.description: Name of the bridge container COMP.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP to build the QLab OSC bridge in.

name: qlab_osc_bridge
title: QLab OSC bridge
